title: Alpha One — event tenant.suspended v1
description: V1 catalog event `tenant.suspended` (v1). Envelope per EVT-03 (see envelope.schema.json). Producer/consumers per contracts/events/catalog.md: consumers = AUTH (kill sessions), GW (deny), NOT-01, AUD — all within 1 s. Derived from: docs/03 §4.1 (tenant.suspended, TEN-15 cascade) + docs/32 `tenants` (suspended_at, suspension_reason). Money is integer minor units (docs/00 #3); the envelope carries tenant_id — no redundant tenant field in the payload.
